DRIVER HUD — Credits and third-party notices

Bingus Shared Loader
Author / maintainer: CowboyBingus
DRIVER HUD uses Bingus Shared Loader V21 Official Fix API 1 addon discovery as its shared
Lua startup path. Bingus Shared Loader is a separate dependency and is not
redistributed with DRIVER HUD.
Nexus Mods: https://www.nexusmods.com/helldivers2/mods/16292

HD2 HUD+
Author: DDRK1NG
Nexus Mods: https://www.nexusmods.com/helldivers2/mods/15298
HD2 HUD+ was an important reference during DRIVER HUD bootstrap/UI research.
DRIVER HUD does not redistribute HD2 HUD+ or its feature modules. A small GUI
material resource retained from early HUD+ based prototyping is used only for
DRIVER HUD's own geometry and remains credited here in accordance with the
HD2 HUD+ reuse permission.

Helldivers 2 and its game assets, names, interfaces and identifiers belong to
their respective owners.

FRV occupancy contribution / Slot-3 artwork
Integration based on DRIVER HUD Occupancy Weapon Icons 1.7.1, the derivative
prepared for Spike in 2026. Its Seater/Inventory layout research and supplied
33 icon masks/resource mappings are credited to that contribution. The base
HUD implementation/design and original MIT notice remain FireScallion's.
The optional icon pack has its own resource and does not redistribute the core.

Icon source: nvigneux / Helldivers-2-Stratagems-icons-svg
https://github.com/nvigneux/Helldivers-2-Stratagems-icons-svg
Resource-name reference: Darctor / Helldivers2_RawData, Data/Hash.csv
https://github.com/Darctor/Helldivers2_RawData
These references and permissions are retained from the supplied 1.7.1 notices.
Third-party artwork is not relicensed as newly authored project code.
